target: Post-trigger peak voltage with training-condition-normalized error
timing_contract: Target is maximum absolute receiver voltage across all t>=0 samples, subtracting each trace mean over t<0. No response-selected time window or denoising. Ten actual waveform columns kept per file. Expanded information budget: distance_mm, resonance_kHz, width_us, condition
calibration: See frozen development protocol and per-fold states; all learned calibration is training-partition-only. w is pulse width in microseconds; f is nominal resonance in cycles per microsecond (kHz/1000). The effective damping time12us was selected on development widths. Six calibrated gains in V are12.271204,0.941597,0.00302123,0.000609934,0.00227582,0.000462384 for(d0,f110),(d0,f500),(d20,f110),(d20,f500),(d50,f110),(d50,f500). The maximum accounts for an initial pulse edge before the second edge; it is a phenomenological peak approximation. Sensor type is confounded with nominal resonance.
independent_unit: whole width block across sensor/distance; six correlated files
reference_selection: First preregistered continuation candidate; other development-ranked candidates remain separate models, not new held-out selections.
